"""Generate single-construct removal variants for the collapsed-unit cohort.
Each variant = the main checkout's verified generated unit with ONE edited TU block substituted
verbatim. Writes OUT/<unit-id>/<owner>__<variant>.c and OUT/manifest.json."""
import json, re, sys, collections
from pathlib import Path

S = Path(sys.argv[1])
OUT = S / "cohort2"
MAIN = Path("/home/armandofm/projects/fzgx")
cohort = json.load(open(S / "cohort.json"))
units = json.load(open(MAIN / "config/GFZE01/units.json"))
by_src = {u["source"]: u for u in units}

PRAGMA = re.compile(r"^[ \t]*#pragma[ \t]+(\w+)[ \t]+(off|on)\b[^\n]*\n", re.M)
CARRIER = re.compile(r"struct \{ (\w[\w ]*?) value; \} (\w+);")
WARN = re.compile(r"^[ \t]*/\* WARNING: compiler-diff device[^\n]*\*/[ \t]*\n", re.M)


def block(tu_text, name):
    m = re.search(r"^/\* fzgx:begin %s(?: [^*]*)? \*/\n" % re.escape(name), tu_text, re.M)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(name)
    i = m.end()
    return tu_text[i:tu_text.index(f"/* fzgx:end {name} */", i)]


def pseudo_block(text, name):
    """Definition of `name` in a marker-less TU, with the contiguous pragma/comment lines just
    before it and the contiguous pragma lines just after its closing brace."""
    m = re.search(r"^[A-Za-z_][^;\n]*\b%s\([^;{]*\)\s*\{[ \t]*$" % re.escape(name), text, re.M)
    if not m:
        return None
    start = m.start()
    while True:
        prev = text.rfind("\n", 0, start - 1) + 1
        line = text[prev:start]
        if prev < start and (line.lstrip().startswith("#pragma") or line.lstrip().startswith("/* WARNING")):
            start = prev
        else:
            break
    end = text.index("\n}\n", m.end()) + 3
    while True:
        nl = text.find("\n", end)
        line = text[end:nl + 1]
        if line.lstrip().startswith("#pragma") and "section" not in line:
            end = nl + 1
        else:
            break
    return text[start:end]


def drop_pragma(text, m):
    """Remove pragma match m and its first following `#pragma NAME reset` (if any)."""
    name = m.group(1)
    t = text[:m.start()] + text[m.end():]
    r = re.compile(r"^[ \t]*#pragma[ \t]+%s[ \t]+reset\b[^\n]*\n" % name, re.M)
    rm = r.search(t, m.start())
    if rm:
        t = t[:rm.start()] + t[rm.end():]
    return t


def drop_carrier(text, m):
    typ, var = m.group(1), m.group(2)
    t = text[:m.start()] + f"{typ} {var};" + text[m.end():]
    return re.sub(r"\b%s\.value\b" % re.escape(var), var, t)


def main():
    owners = collections.OrderedDict()
    for f in cohort:
        owners.setdefault((f["unit"], f["owner"], f["path"]), []).append(f)
    manifest = []
    for (unit_src, owner, path), fs in owners.items():
        name = owner.split(":", 1)[1]
        tu = (MAIN / path).read_text()
        try:
            blk = block(tu, name)
        except ValueError:
            blk = pseudo_block(tu, name)
            print("pseudo-block:", owner)
            if blk is None:
                manifest.append({"owner": owner, "unit": unit_src, "error": "definition not found in " + path})
                continue
        gp = MAIN / "build/GFZE01/gen" / unit_src
        gen = (gp if gp.exists() else MAIN / "src" / unit_src).read_text()
        if gen.count(blk) != 1:
            manifest.append({"owner": owner, "unit": unit_src, "error": f"block occurs {gen.count(blk)}x in gen"})
            continue
        variants = {}
        pms = list(PRAGMA.finditer(blk))
        for k, m in enumerate(pms):
            variants[f"p{k}_{m.group(1)}"] = drop_pragma(blk, m)
        cms = list(CARRIER.finditer(blk))
        for k, m in enumerate(cms):
            variants[f"c{k}_{m.group(2)}"] = drop_carrier(blk, m)
        if len(pms) + len(cms) > 1:
            t = blk
            while True:
                m = PRAGMA.search(t)
                if not m:
                    break
                t = drop_pragma(t, m)
            while True:
                m = CARRIER.search(t)
                if not m:
                    break
                t = drop_carrier(t, m)
            variants["all"] = t
        d = OUT / unit_src.replace("/", "__")
        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for vk, vb in variants.items():
            assert vb != blk, (owner, vk)
            p = d / f"{name}__{vk}.c"
            p.write_text(gen.replace(blk, vb))
            manifest.append({"owner": owner, "unit": unit_src, "variant": vk, "file": str(p),
                             "mw": by_src[unit_src].get("mw_version") or "GC/1.3.2"})
    json.dump(manifest, open(OUT / "manifest.json", "w"), indent=1)
    print(len(manifest), "entries;", sum(1 for m in manifest if "error" in m), "errors")
    for m in manifest:
        if "error" in m:
            print(m)


main()

engine_archive.py.text:
"""Record collapsed-unit device-inverse probes through the shared repair engine and archive them.
usage: engine_archive.py SCRATCH OUTDIR [--smoke]   (run from the worktree root)
Every body is a whole collapsed unit (the verified generated unit with one edit), recorded
against the owner function's retail object with the unit's actual compiler profile."""
import sys, json, re, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'tools')
from fzgx import fixup, oracle
from fzgx.project import Project

S = Path(sys.argv[1]); out = Path(sys.argv[2]); smoke = '--smoke' in sys.argv
MAIN = Path('/home/armandofm/projects/fzgx')
p = Project('GFZE01'); e = fixup.Engine(p, out); rows = []
units = {u['source']: u for u in json.load(open(MAIN / 'config/GFZE01/units.json'))}


def base_text(unit_src):
    g = MAIN / 'build/GFZE01/gen' / unit_src
    return (g if g.exists() else MAIN / 'src' / unit_src).read_text()


def profile(unit_src):
    """mw and unit extra flags exactly as configured for the collapsed unit."""
    u = units[unit_src]
    s = p.resolve(u['module'] + ':' + u['symbols'][0]) if u['symbols'][0] in ('_prolog', '_epilog') else p.resolve(u['symbols'][0])
    mw, flags = oracle.version_for(p, s)
    return mw, flags


controls = {}


def control(owner, unit_src):
    if owner not in controls:
        mw, flags = profile(unit_src)
        controls[owner] = e.record(owner, base_text(unit_src), mw, flags, label='installed collapsed-unit control',
                                   unit=unit_src)
        rows.append(controls[owner])
    return controls[owner]


def add(owner, unit_src, path, label):
    base = control(owner, unit_src)
    text = Path(path).read_text()
    assert text != base_text(unit_src), (owner, label)
    row = e.record(owner, text, base['mw'], base['flags'], parent=base['id'], label=label, unit=unit_src)
    rows.append(row)
    return row


cohort = [m for m in json.load(open(S / 'cohort2/manifest.json')) if 'file' in m]
manual = [  # earlier hand probes (fixed hypotheses), each a whole-unit variant
    ('car_colchg:fn_9_AF0', 'rel/car_colchg/car_colchg/_prolog.c', S / 'af0', 'chan comma-device natural alternative: '),
    ('car_colchg:fn_9_AF0', 'rel/car_colchg/car_colchg/_prolog.c', [S / 'cc/nocomma.c', S / 'cc/rgbdirect.c'], 'chan comma-device removal: '),
    ('car_colchg:colchg_chgcol_disp', 'rel/car_colchg/car_colchg/_prolog.c', S / 'chg', 'chgcol opt_lifetimes removal: '),
    ('car_colchg:colchg_selmate_disp', 'rel/car_colchg/car_colchg/_prolog.c', S / 'sel2', 'selmate carrier removal: '),
    ('main_rel:fn_1_A6480', 'rel/main_rel/prog/fn_1_A5D88.c', S / 'prog', 'pad volatile-view removal, access spelling: '),
    ('main_rel:fn_1_A6480', 'rel/main_rel/prog/fn_1_A5D88.c', S / 'prog2', 'pad volatile-view removal, inline helper: '),
    ('main_rel:fn_1_D42A8', 'rel/main_rel/mdlload/fn_1_D35D4.c', S / 'd42', 'distance clamp without opt_common_subs: '),
    ('main_rel:fn_1_D42A8', 'rel/main_rel/mdlload/fn_1_D35D4.c', [S / 'mdl/tu_nocse.c'], 'TU-wide opt_common_subs off: '),
    ('main_rel:fn_1_56D4C', 'rel/main_rel/shadowmap/fn_1_5672C.c', S / 'shd', 'translation copy without volatile view: '),
    ('main_rel:fn_1_56D4C', 'rel/main_rel/shadowmap/fn_1_5672C.c', S / 'shd2', 'translation copy decl order/helper: '),
]
todo = []
for owner, unit_src, src, label in manual:
    files = sorted(src.glob('*.c')) if isinstance(src, Path) else src
    for f in files:
        if f.name in ('control.c', 'ctl.c'):
            continue
        todo.append((owner, unit_src, f, label + f.stem))
for m in cohort:
    todo.append((m['owner'], m['unit'], Path(m['file']), 'collapsed-unit cohort: ' + m['variant']))
if smoke:
    keep = {('car_colchg:colchg_chgcol_disp', 'carid_first_x1'), ('car_colchg:colchg_selmate_disp', 'plain')}
    todo = [t for t in todo if (t[0], t[2].stem) in keep]
for t in todo:
    add(*t)
# the accepted, installed forms (worktree's regenerated units) for every changed owner
INSTALLED = {
    'car_colchg:colchg_chgcol_disp': 'rel/car_colchg/car_colchg/_prolog.c',
    'sel:fn_10_A480': 'rel/sel/sel/fn_10_0.c', 'sel:fn_10_1544': 'rel/sel/sel/fn_10_0.c',
    'sel:fn_10_5E94': 'rel/sel/sel/fn_10_0.c',
    'story:fn_7_44DC': 'rel/story/story_mode/fn_7_41FC.c', 'story:fn_7_4648': 'rel/story/story_mode/fn_7_41FC.c',
}
if not smoke:
    for owner, unit_src in INSTALLED.items():
        g = Path('build/GFZE01/gen') / unit_src
        add(owner, unit_src, g if g.exists() else Path('src') / unit_src, 'accepted installed form')
with oracle.build_lock():
    e.evaluate(rows)
for r in rows:
    if r.get('object'):
        e.check(r)
report = dict(hypothesis='Collapsed TUs give MWCC whole-unit context that per-function device sweeps never measured; '
                         'remove each marked device, optimizer-pragma pair and one-field carrier owned by a function '
                         'in a multi-function unit, one at a time, and accept only object-identical results.',
              stopping_condition='One pass over the 75 census spots in 14 collapsed units (single removals plus all-at-once '
                                 'per function) and fixed hand hypotheses for the nine newly marked devices; no flags, '
                                 'allocator or search. Stop after the pass.',
              records=rows, best={}, frontier={'all_frozen_probes': rows},
              generator_sha256=e.generator_sha256, environment=e.environment)
(out / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=1, default=str) + '\n')
fixup.archive_sources(report, out / 'sources.json.gz')
for r in rows:
    print(r['symbol'], '|', r['label'], '|', bool(r.get('matched')), r.get('word_errors'), r.get('extra_helpers'))

unitcheck.py.text:
"""Compile a variant of a collapsed unit's generated C with the unit's configured compiler
and flags, then objdiff the whole object against the retail target.
usage: unitcheck.py UNIT_NAME VARIANT.c [VARIANT2.c ...]   (run from the worktree root)
Prints, per variant, every symbol/section of the target below 100% (empty = whole unit matches)."""
import json, shlex, subprocess, sys, os
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OBJDIFF = ROOT / "build/tools/objdiff-cli"
units = {u["name"]: u for u in json.load(open(ROOT / "objdiff.json"))["units"]}


def main():
    name = sys.argv[1]
    u = units[name]
    sc = u["scratch"]
    flags = sc["c_flags"]
    mw = os.environ["MW"]
    target = Path(os.environ.get("REFROOT", "/home/armandofm/projects/fzgx")) / (u["base_path"] if os.environ.get("REF", "built") == "built" else u["target_path"])
    print("reference:", target)
    out_dir = Path(os.environ.get("OUT", "/tmp/claude-1000/-home-armandofm-projects-fzgx/87b8ef80-0e14-4ea8-9c4c-508103c3951d/scratchpad/obj"))
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for var in sys.argv[2:]:
        obj = out_dir / (Path(var).stem + ".o")
        cmd = [str(ROOT / "build/tools/wibo"), str(ROOT / "build/compilers" / mw / "mwcceppc.exe")]
        cmd += shlex.split(flags) + ["-i", "include", "-i", "build/GFZE01/include", "-c", var, "-o", str(obj)]
        cp = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT, text=True, capture_output=True)
        if cp.returncode != 0:
            print(f"{var}: COMPILE FAILED\n{(cp.stdout + cp.stderr)[-1500:]}")
            continue
        # apply the unit's pool retargeting, as ninja's mwcc_pool rule does
        pool = os.environ.get("POOL")
        if pool:
            subprocess.run(shlex.split(pool) + [str(obj)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
        cp = subprocess.run([str(OBJDIFF), "diff", "-1", str(target), "-2", str(obj), "-o", "-", "--format", "json"],
                            text=True, capture_output=True)
        data = json.loads(cp.stdout)
        bad = []
        for s in data.get("left", {}).get("symbols", []):
            mp = s.get("match_percent")
            if mp is not None and mp < 100.0:
                bad.append(f"  sym {s['name']}: {mp:.3f}")
        for s in data.get("left", {}).get("sections", []):
            mp = s.get("match_percent")
            if mp is not None and mp < 100.0:
                bad.append(f"  sec {s['name']}: {mp:.3f}")
        print(f"{var}: {'MATCH' if not bad else 'DIFF'}")
        print("\n".join(bad))


main()
